The fix belongs in recursive discovery/path-ignore evaluation; TOML parsing already loads nested `MASTER` values correctly and should not be redesigned.
contract.summary: Fix recursive discovery so `ignore-paths` consistently evaluates both directory roots and individual discovered Python files against CWD-relative path candidates, while retaining the existing traversal-path candidate for backward compatibility. CWD-relative candidates must be available for both relative and absolute recursive target arguments, including `../` segments for targets outside the current working directory, and must support POSIX and Windows separators. With `[tool.pylint.MASTER] ignore-paths = ["^src/gen/.*$"]`, running `pylint --recursive=y src/` from the project root must exclude all files under `src/gen/`. Add regression coverage proving configuration loaded from `pyproject.toml` works in recursive mode, since existing recursive tests cover only command-line configuration.
